title: Repair artifact previews and log rendering
summary: Resolved recorded artifact paths through a shared client mapper and a bounded repository file endpoint, then replaced generic screenshot-shaped placeholders with type-aware image, log, and file presentations.
userVisibleChange: Playwright screenshots now render in repository and standalone snapshot views. Log artifacts now show readable terminal-style previews and an expanded modal instead of empty image placeholders, with explicit empty and unavailable states.

risks.title: Recorded external temporary files may later disappear
risks.mitigation: The UI reports an explicit unavailable state instead of showing a broken image or empty frame.

timeline.title: Locked artifact rendering repair plan
timeline.summary: Scoped the fix to artifact path resolution, bounded file serving, type-aware presentation, and regression coverage.

timeline.title: Added recorded-file resolution and artifact-specific UI
timeline.summary: Introduced a shared artifact resolver, a server endpoint restricted to snapshot-recorded paths, image previews, terminal-style log previews, and compact generic file cards.

timeline.title: Verified tests, build, and real browser behavior
timeline.summary: Ran UI and Go suites, built embedded UI assets, and exercised repository and standalone snapshot views through Playwright.

decisions.title: Serve only paths already recorded in snapshots
decisions.rationale: Repository-relative and absolute evidence paths need to be retrievable, but the endpoint must not become a general filesystem browser. Exact snapshot membership and repository containment checks bound access.

decisions.title: Render evidence according to artifact type
decisions.rationale: Images benefit from visual previews, logs need selectable monospace text, and generic files need compact file affordances rather than misleading image placeholders.

decisions.title: Bound log preview reads
decisions.rationale: Range requests cap browser transfer at 128 KiB and card rendering at 4,000 characters while preserving an expanded readable view.

validation.output: Production Vite build completed successfully; existing chunk-size advisory only.

validation.command: Playwright live artifact rendering check at http://localhost:4329
validation.output: Repository artifact cards rendered real log previews and Playwright screenshots; image and log modals opened; standalone snapshot images loaded at natural widths 1440 and 390; browser console had zero errors and warnings.
